title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E9 — Authentic Greek Cuisine
Martha and Chef Costas Spiliadis of Estiatorio Milos make Taramasalata and salad; they build an eggplant and zucchini tower with tzatziki; then, they salt-bake a fish served with yogurt.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E5 — Shellfish
Martha takes shellfish to the next level with sustainable oysters, baked stuffed clams and more.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E4 — Chef David Burke's Modern Classics
Chef David Burke brings his modern classic dishes to Martha's kitchen; a bacon clothesline, calamari noodles, miso chicken with ginger and vegetables, and key lime pie are on the menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E6 — Sensational Summer Salads
Martha and Salad Freak author Jess Dameck reveal the art of constructing the perfect salad; Martha and Sarah Carey share a new twist on the classic Caesar salad and create a roasted beet salad.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E7 — Martha Throws a Clam Bake
Martha heads to her local seafood market, Mt. Kisco Seafood, to pick up the perfect ingredients for a clam bake; broiled salmon and delicious creamed spinach.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E8 — Rustic Italian Cuisine
Martha visits Il Buco Alimentari with chef Justin Smillie and fries artichokes to crispy perfection; they construct a salad with anchovy crumbs followed by spaghetti bottarga and charred duck.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E4 — Tropical Plants That Can Grow Anywhere
Martha travels to Florida for all things tropical plants; Martha explores inspiring gardens and landscapes in Palm Beach, highlighting diverse varieties of tropical plants that can be grown anywhere.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E5 — Container Gardening Made Easy
Martha shares the dos and don'ts of container gardening from choosing what to plant and the right container to sharing her key tips for nutrient-rich soil; a glossary of underplantings to give potted plants a finished look.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E6 — Growing Fruit and Berries
Martha shares tips on the many different varieties of fruits and berries she cultivates on her farm; a lesson on growing raspberries, currants, and blueberries; Matt Kaminsky teaches Martha how to prune and care for her hundred-year-old apple trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E1 — Martha's Amazing Maze and How to Grow Trees From Seedlings
Martha's new passion project is the maze she's building on her Bedford farm; she shares her plans and inspiration for the project and teaches the proper measuring, staking and fertilizing techniques to properly plant successful trees.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S3 E27 — Topiaries; Clematis; Staking Good Thing
Topiaries; staking peonies; clematis.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S4 E2 — Composting 101; Compost Sifter; Homemade Mozzarella
Composting 101; compost sifter; mozzarella; string holder good thing.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S4 E7 — Halloween: Scarecrow; Peanut Brittle; Window Creatures
Peanut brittle; trick-or-treat bag; scarecrow; Halloween window decorations.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S4 E8 — Bread Pudding; Mattress Maker; Perfect Pot of Tea
Bread pudding; mattress making and care; tea.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S4 E9 — Indian Food; Votive Jelly Jar Candles; Corn Garland
Ismail Merchant cooks Indian cuisine; corn garland.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S4 E10 — Raisin Pie; Cranberry Bog; Spiced Cranberry Mold
Thanksgiving.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S5 E9 — Extraordinary Fruits
Souffle with passion fruit; mango upside-down cake; biscuit-topped raspberry-rhubarb cobblers.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E3 — Chocolate Ganache
Dark chocolate filling for an almond-based tart shell; chocolate ganache frosting for a devil's food cake; milk chocolate pudding cupcakes.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E4 — Sponge Cake
Raspberry whipped cream jelly roll; multitiered caramel buttercream cake; making ladyfingers for tiramisu ice cream cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E5 — Frangipane
Incorporating frangipane into bostock and a classic English Bakewell tart; apricot tart made with hazelnut frangipane; pecan-frangipane coffee cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E7 — Never Enough Cookies
Giant fruit and nut kitchen sink cookies; vanilla sugar cookie sorbet sandwiches; maple-pecan shortbread squares; double chocolate sandwich cookies.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E9 — One-Bowl Desserts
Brown-butter coconut cashew blondies; skilled baked plum cake; single-serving size brownie sundaes; Scottish oatcakes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E9 — Exploring Korean Cuisine
Martha dines at the Korean restaurant NARO and begins her culinary journey with two Korean cocktails; Martha and executive chef Nate Kuester make reimagined versions of traditional Korean cuisine.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E10 — Martha's Favorite Brunch
Martha prepares a brunch menu with whitefish salad from Acme Smoked Fish Corp and crafts a cocktail featuring two brunch staples; Martha makes her favorite frittata dish and bakes a rhubarb crisp.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E1 — Ice Cream Show
Martha makes homemade ice cream with Van Leeuwen Ice Cream co-founder, Ben Van Leeuwen; Martha assembles ice cream sandwiches with homemade cookies and makes hot fudge.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E3 — Mexican Cuisine
Chef Lazaro Perez joins Martha in her kitchen to cook a fiesta-inspired feast of carnitas and homemade tortillas, shrimp in a spicy chili sauce, and the iconic Martha-rita.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E5 — Brioche, Tarts and Pie
Chef Margarita Lorenzana-Manzke visits Martha's Maple Avenue kitchen and shares recipes of her famous staples from her restaurant, Republique, like banana caramel cream pie and brioche loaves.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E6 — Tomato Show
Martha shares her favorite tomato recipes from a tomato tart to Martha's favorite BLT to a simple marinara sauce.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E7 — French Bistro Night
Martha gets a first-hand look behind the delicious French dishes at Cenadou Bistro including mussels in a tomato sauce with house-made croutons and a flatbread topped with olives and anchovies.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E8 — The Science of Woks and Frying
Martha and Chef Kenji Lopez-Alt make extra-crunchy fried chicken sandwiches, tempura shrimp with vegetables, and finally a perfectly stir-fried beef with broccoli.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:

Steamed artichokes with tarragon butter; braised leeks; fried okra; whole-roasted garlic.

Béarnaise sauce; Kansas City barbecue sauce; tartar sauce with capers, shallots and cornichons; cocktail sauce; salsa verde.

Porchetta, a highly seasoned roasted pork; glazed ham; pork and plums.
